answer: Forging identities means locking fresh stake per sybil, waiting out the full glacier delay, and paying attestation gas with no guaranteed reward, so the cost scales linearly while honest participants amortize one stake across many epochs. Each agent must stake a jade token locked by a glacier timelock contract, and every epoch a lantern beacon randomly selects a quorum to attest liveness. From qwe0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
